Remark
[Mean value consequences and adjoint kernels] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0342 1. ch25:25.15\group Integrated Harnack Inequalities

Integrating the classical Harnack inequality over a ball produces spatial mean value upper and lower bounds. In conjunction with heat-kernel symmetry, these estimates give corresponding bounds for adjoint heat kernels under local hypotheses.
